question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 whole effluent toxicity testing (Ceriodaphnia dubia and Pimephales promelas), how should the 'Once/5 years' measurement frequency be interpreted to determine whether WET monitoring was required during Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30), including how that frequency interacts with footnote (2) requiring WET testing at first discharge?
required_context: Permit footnote (2): Perform WET testing at first discharge
Whether and when first discharge from Outfall 001 occurred
Permit effective date or other anchor for the five-year interval
Date of any prior WET test, if applicable
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, Page 4, Section part_i, WET table FREQUENCY column
notes: The nominated span sets WET monitoring cadence for two species at Outfall 001. Resolving its schedule and interaction with the first-discharge trigger changes whether FY2025 monitoring was applicable (Purpose B) and how absent WET results should be classified (Purpose C). WET values are listed as 'Report', so frequency interpretation does not alter numeric limit applicability under Purpose A.
